oracle: Single-threaded pinned GGML generic CPU, contraction disabled.
fields: Decimal width, tokens, slots, per-lane gate and strided flags followed by binary32 output words in hexadecimal.
dimensions: Use four value heads and two sequences. Q has two heads and one sequence. K has one head and two sequences. Gates use one or width lanes per head.
views: For strided Q/K/V allocate [width+2,tokens,heads,sequences]. Use a one-word offset, swap strides 1 and 2 and keep stride 3. Other inputs and output are contiguous.
inputs: For input slot s and logical index [i0,i1,i2,i3] let n=i0+7*i1+11*i2+13*i3+5*s. Gate = -(n%7)/16, beta = (n%8)/8, all other inputs = (n%19-9)/16. Initialize the entire output to 13.25.
baseline: The vTensor provider refused upstream factory ordinal 27498 before allocation. The GPU-free CPU reference completed all 72 supplemental graphs.
